data.narrative:
Persona AI is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Nic Radford and Jerry Pratt that has raised $25M to date. The broader sector comprises 8 private peers including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Bedrock Robotics, alongside 1 public comparable (ticker 277810.KQ).

Given data constraints, only one valuation method was applicable. Stage-Progression analysis uses the $25M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement in venture-backed companies, yielding a $62M implied valuation. This method anchors to the company's actual capital deployment rather than speculative revenue or margin multiples.

Peer-Median analysis was not viable due to insufficient comparable datapoints meeting tight filtering criteria—while 8 same-sector peers exist, fewer than three meet narrow stage and tier alignment requirements. A broader sector median would introduce undue noise given heterogeneity in robotics subsegments and funding profiles.

The triangulated range is $53M to $72M, with a median of $62M. This analysis rests on a single methodological pillar, creating material uncertainty. Key unknowns include the company's revenue run rate, gross margins, and the degree to which its technology positioning commands sector multiples relative to broader manufacturing software or hardware benchmarks. Additional comparable data or revenue visibility would materially strengthen conviction in this range.
